name: β-Pinene
summary: A pine-and-herbal monoterpene profile linked from MONDAYS product language.
evidence: Measured in 6 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 1.62–14.29% of total volatiles (0.32–2.86mg per chew).

pubchem.title: Beta-Pinene
pubchem.description: Beta-pinene is an isomer of pinene with an exocyclic double bond. It is a component of essential oils from many plants. It has a role as a plant metabolite.
